title: In which year was the Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) established in India?
explanation: The Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) was established in 1926 following the Lee Commission recommendations.

title: Which manufacturing division delivered its 2,000th aero-engine in October 2026, marking six decades of aero-engine production?
explanation: Hindustan Aeronautics Limited (HAL) Koraput division in Odisha achieved the milestone of delivering its 2,000th aero-engine.

title: A free-flow tolling system requires vehicles to stop at barriers to scan physical toll receipts.
explanation: A Multi-Lane Free Flow tolling system is barrierless, allowing vehicles to pass without stopping at conventional physical toll gates.

title: In which year was the Paris Agreement on climate change adopted under the UNFCCC?
explanation: The Paris Agreement was adopted by 196 parties at COP21 in Paris on 12 December 2015.

title: What catastrophic mountain hazard does the meteorological abbreviation 'GLOF' stand for?
explanation: GLOF stands for Glacial Lake Outburst Flood, a sudden catastrophic breach and drainage of glacial meltwater lakes in high mountain ranges.

title: Which international convention regulates global trade in specimens of endangered wild animals and plants?
explanation: Verified science/space fact: CITES.

title: What is the name of the imaginary line at 0° latitude that divides the Earth into the Northern and Southern Hemispheres?
explanation: The Equator is the 0° latitude line dividing the Northern and Southern hemispheres.

title: Which is India's smallest Union Territory by land area, situated in the Arabian Sea?
explanation: Lakshadweep, with its capital at Kavaratti, is India's smallest Union Territory.

title: What is the administrative capital of the Union Territory of Puducherry?
explanation: The administrative capital of Puducherry is Puducherry.

title: What term describes a published written account of a person's life composed by that person themselves?
explanation: An autobiography is the life story of a person written by that person themselves.

title: Who wrote the acclaimed literary work 'The God of Small Things'?
explanation: 'The God of Small Things' was written by Arundhati Roy.

title: Who wrote the acclaimed literary work 'Charlotte's Web'?
explanation: 'Charlotte's Web' was written by E. B. White.

title: Which landmark film released in 1913 directed by Dadasaheb Phalke is recognized as India's first full-length feature film?
explanation: Raja Harishchandra (1913) directed by Dadasaheb Phalke was India's first full-length silent feature film.

title: 'Bhangra' is a celebrated traditional folk dance originating from which Indian State?
explanation: Bhangra is a vibrant folk dance belonging to Punjab.

title: The famous traditional art form 'Tanjore painting' is indigenous to which Indian State?
explanation: Tanjore painting is a celebrated traditional visual art heritage of Tamil Nadu.

title: Which human organ is recognized as the largest organ of the human body overall?
explanation: The skin is the largest organ of the human body, serving as a protective barrier and sensory organ.

title: Which Scottish physician and microbiologist discovered the world's first effective natural antibiotic, Penicillin, in 1928?
explanation: Sir Alexander Fleming discovered penicillin from Penicillium notatum mould in 1928.

title: Who discovered X-rays in 1895, earning the inaugural Nobel Prize in Physics?
explanation: Verified fact from health syllabus: Wilhelm Conrad Röntgen.

title: What does the foundational computer hardware acronym 'CPU' stand for?
explanation: CPU stands for Central Processing Unit, commonly called the brain of the computer.

title: In digital technology and computing, what does the abbreviation 'QR code' stand for?
explanation: 'QR code' stands for Quick Response code.

title: What is the primary computer architecture function of the Graphics Processing Unit (GPU)?
correct: Accelerating mathematical parallel processing for graphics and AI workloads
options: Accelerating mathematical parallel processing for graphics and AI workloads
explanation: Verified fact: Accelerating mathematical parallel processing for graphics and AI workloads.

title: Which landmark scientific discovery is commemorated every year on 28 February as India's National Science Day?
correct: Raman Effect (discovered by Sir C. V. Raman in 1928)
options: Discovery of the Zero by Aryabhata
Raman Effect (discovered by Sir C. V. Raman in 1928)
Discovery of Cosmic Radiations by Homi Bhabha
explanation: National Science Day on 28 February commemorates the discovery of the Raman Effect by Sir C. V. Raman.

title: Which environmental date commemorates the signing of the Montreal Protocol on substances that deplete the ozone layer?
explanation: World Ozone Day is celebrated annually on 16 September.

title: Which day celebrated on 20 May raises global awareness about the ecological importance of pollinators such as honeybees?
explanation: World Bee Day is observed on 20 May to recognize the critical role of bees and other pollinators in ecosystems.

title: What is the official state animal of Tamil Nadu, native to the rocky crags of the Western Ghats?
explanation: The state animal of Tamil Nadu is the Nilgiri tahr (an endangered mountain ungulate), NOT the tiger.

title: Which hill station in the Western Ghats of Tamil Nadu is famously known as the 'Princess of Hill Stations'?
explanation: Verified Tamil Nadu heritage fact: Kodaikanal (Palani Hills).

title: What is the height of the monumental stone statue of saint-poet Thiruvalluvar erected on an island off Kanyakumari?
explanation: Verified Tamil Nadu heritage fact: 133 feet (representing 133 chapters of Thirukkural).

title: Which historic southern city in Tamil Nadu is famously known as the 'Athens of the East' and the 'Temple City'?
explanation: Madurai is celebrated as the 'Athens of the East' because of its ancient cultural heritage, Greek trade ties, and towering temple architecture.

title: In which Indian State is the sacred pilgrimage shrine of Sri Venkateswara Temple on Tirumala hills situated?
explanation: Tirupati and the Sri Venkateswara Temple on Tirumala are located in Andhra Pradesh (Tirupati district), NOT in Tamil Nadu.

title: Which deep-water multi-purpose commercial transshipment port project is located near Thiruvananthapuram in Kerala?
explanation: Vizhinjam Port in Kerala is an international deep-water multipurpose container transshipment hub.

title: Which country holds the G20 Presidency in 2026?
explanation: The United States holds the G20 Presidency in 2026.

title: What is the official capital city of Japan?
explanation: The capital of Japan is Tokyo.

title: What is the capital city of Pakistan?
explanation: The capital city of Pakistan is Islamabad.

title: Which numbered President of India is Droupadi Murmu?
explanation: Droupadi Murmu took office in July 2022 as the 15th President of India.

title: What percentage of seats is reserved for women in the Lok Sabha and State Assemblies under the 106th Constitutional Amendment?
explanation: The Constitution (106th Amendment) Act, 2023 provides 33% reservation for women in the Lok Sabha and State Legislative Assemblies.

title: A Republic is a state where the head of state is a hereditary monarch rather than an elected official.
explanation: In a Republic, the head of state is elected by the people or their representatives, not a hereditary monarch.

title: What is the total financial outlay approved for India's Research, Development and Innovation (RDI) Scheme?
explanation: The RDI Scheme has an overall outlay of ₹1 lakh crore over 6 years to promote private-sector R&D in strategic technologies.

title: How many supercomputers were deployed under India's National Supercomputing Mission (NSM) by September 2026?
explanation: 40 supercomputers with an aggregate compute capacity of approximately 68 petaflops were deployed under NSM by September 2026.

title: Machine Learning is an umbrella concept that encompasses all forms of Artificial Intelligence.
explanation: Machine Learning is a subset/approach within Artificial Intelligence, not the reverse.

title: In which year was the Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO) formally established?
explanation: ISRO was founded in 1969 under the Department of Space, with headquarters in Bengaluru.

title: Who became the first Indian to visit the International Space Station (ISS) as part of the Axiom-4 mission in 2025?
explanation: Group Captain Shubhanshu Shukla became the first Indian to visit the ISS and the second Indian citizen in space after Rakesh Sharma.

title: What is the planned mission objective of India's upcoming Chandrayaan-4 lunar mission?
explanation: Verified science/space fact: Lunar sample return to Earth.

title: Which city and prefecture hosted the 20th Asian Games from September to October 2026?
explanation: The 20th Asian Games were held in the Aichi-Nagoya region of Japan from 19 September to 4 October 2026.

title: Which Indian boxer won the gold medal in the women's 75 kg category at the 2026 Asian Games?
explanation: Lovlina Borgohain secured gold in the women's 75 kg boxing event.

title: FIDE is the international governing body for competitive professional football.
explanation: FIDE (Fédération Internationale des Échecs) is the governing body for chess. Football is governed by FIFA.

title: In which year was the Bharat Ratna, India's highest civilian honour, instituted?
explanation: The Bharat Ratna was instituted on 2 January 1954 by the President of India.

title: Which major American entertainment award recognizes excellence in Broadway theatre productions?
explanation: The Antoinette Perry Awards for Excellence in Broadway Theatre, commonly known as the Tony Awards, honour live Broadway productions.

title: The Pritzker Prize is regarded as the highest international honour in which creative professional field?
explanation: The Pritzker Architecture Prize is widely recognized as the Nobel Prize of architecture.

title: Which parliamentary constituency does Prime Minister Narendra Modi represent in the Lok Sabha?
explanation: Prime Minister Narendra Modi represents the Varanasi constituency in Uttar Pradesh.

title: Which Indian mathematician from the Indian Institute of Science (IISc), Bengaluru, was awarded the prestigious Ramanujan Prize in 2026 for work in algebraic number theory?
explanation: Professor Mahesh Kakde of IISc Bengaluru was awarded the 2026 Ramanujan Prize for outstanding contributions to algebraic number theory.

title: Who serves as the Secretary-General of the United Nations headquartered in New York?
explanation: António Guterres is the Secretary-General of the United Nations.

title: What does the foundational economic abbreviation 'GDP' stand for?
explanation: GDP stands for Gross Domestic Product, representing the total monetary value of final goods and services produced within a country's borders.

title: How much effective capital expenditure (Capex) was allocated by the Union Government for FY2026–27?
explanation: Effective capital expenditure for FY2026–27 was budgeted at ₹17.15 lakh crore, representing approximately 4.4% of GDP.

title: According to the World Bank's October 2026 update, private AI investment in India expanded to how much in 2025?
explanation: Private AI investment in India grew rapidly from US$1.2 billion in 2024 to US$4.1 billion in 2025.
